map.全球公顷，按全球平均生产力标准化的土地面积单位，便于不同用地可比。结果按公开标准: Global hectare, a land-area unit standardized by global average productivity, enabling comparison across land uses. Results are estimated per public standards and emission factors, for popular science, teaching and emission-reduction reference; for formal accounting follow official guidelines (e.g., GHG Protocol, provincial carbon emission factors) and measured data.

Results are estimated per public standards and emission factors, for popular science, teaching and emission-reduction reference; for formal accounting follow official guidelines (e.g., GHG Protocol, provincial carbon emission factors) and measured data.
